issue.title: [bug] Atom fallback can hide Chinese notes when translated headings stay English
issue.body:
## Summary When `usemagpie.ai` falls back from the GitHub Releases API to `releases.atom`, a release whose translated section keeps an English heading can be split at the wrong place. In a Chinese UI, the latest release then contains only its `安装` section; the client strips that section and drops the release entirely. This happened with `v0.1.1289`: the update dialog said it was updating to `v0.1.1289`, but the first entry shown was `v0.1.1288`. This is different from #2260: `v0.1.1289` has Chinese notes below a `` marker in the GitHub release. The problem occurs while reconstructing that marker from the Atom feed. ## Reproduction observed on 2026-10-18 The release page for `v0.1.1289` contains four Chinese improvement bullets: https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/tag/v0.1.1289 At approximately `2026-10-18 21:01 UTC`, the Chinese notes endpoint returned only the install section for that release: ```console $ curl -i 'https://usemagpie.ai/api/notes?after=0.1.1288&upto=0.1.1289&lang=zh' HTTP/1.1 200 OK Cache-Control: public, max-age=60 {"releases":[{"version":"0.1.1289","notes":"### 安装\n\n从 [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai) 下载，或运行 `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`。已安装的 magpie 会自动更新。", ...}]} ``` The 60-second cache lifetime indicates the degraded/Atom fallback path. The default/English request from the same fallback response contained the English notes followed by the Chinese improvement section, rather than English alone: ```console $ curl 'https://usemagpie.ai/api/notes?after=0.1.1288&upto=0.1.1289&lang=en' ``` Its `notes` included both: ```markdown ## Improvements - Improved session overview performance ... ### Install ... ## Improvements - 通过仅读取一次会话文件来计算统计信息和原生会话，提升了会话概览性能。 ... ``` ## Cause `site/worker.js` restores the marker removed by GitHub's Atom feed before the first *heading* containing Han characters: ```js const isZh = HAN.test(text); if (isZh && english && !zh) { lines.push("", ZH); zh = true; } ``` For `v0.1.1289`, the translated section starts with the untranslated heading: ```markdown ## Improvements - 通过仅读取一次会话文件来计算统计信息和原生会话，提升了会话概览性能。 ``` Because `Improvements` contains no Han characters, the parser does not recognize the Chinese section there. The first later heading containing Han characters is `### 安装`, so the restored `` marker is inserted immediately before `安装`. Consequently: - `lang=zh` receives only the install section. - `lang=en` receives the English section plus the Chinese improvement section. The client then makes the Chinese symptom look like a completely missing release: - `internal/update/notes.go` calls `StripInstall` for each release. - If the remaining notes are empty, `Between` drops the release. - Therefore `v0.1.1289` disappears and the dialog begins at `v0.1.1288`. ## Expected behavior - `lang=zh` returns the Chinese improvement section for `v0.1.1289`. - `lang=en` returns only the English section. - The update dialog includes `v0.1.1289` as its first entry. ## Suggested regression case Add an Atom-feed fixture where both language sections use the same English heading but the second section has Chinese list items: ```html

Improvements

  • Improved the English path.

Install

Download it.

Improvements

  • 改进了中文路径。

安装

下载它。

``` The current fixture uses a translated heading such as `新功能`, so it does not cover this boundary. The Atom fallback should reconstruct the language boundary without relying only on the script used by headings. Configuring `GITHUB_TOKEN` would reduce how often the fallback is needed, but the fallback parser should still handle this valid release shape.

comments.body:
Delivered on `fix/atom-zh-sections` ([7aa04408](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/7aa04408), skygunner's fork, on upstream/main 42976f9a): `notes()` now finds where the Chinese begins by the blocks' own words, not a heading's characters.

The split goes at the first Chinese-led block — Han characters, at least as many as Latin letters, so a brand name inside an English line does not move it — and lands under the heading that block sits behind, so the translated list keeps its (English) heading. A heading of Chinese alone splits exactly where it did before; a release with no English above never splits, as before; a Chinese word inside an English bullet does not split at all.

Red before, on the shape you measured (English Improvements with an English bullet, a second Improvements over Chinese bullets, then 安装): the marker went before 安装 — the zh half was the install paragraph alone (which the client strips, dropping the release — your 0.1.1289-shows-0.1.1288 case) and the en half carried 通过仅读取… after the English. After, zh holds the Chinese bullets under their Improvements plus the install section, en the English alone.

Run: `node --test site/` 32 green (was 21; the new test is your reproduction as a fixture), `go test ./internal/update -count=1` 47 green. Not deployed anywhere — the worker change is on the fork for cherry-picking; the live edge is yours.
